parameters.query: SELECT id, tenant_id, domain, proposed_payload, outcome_type, final_payload, feedback_note, delta_analysis, created_at FROM decision_outcomes WHERE tenant_id = COALESCE($1, 'default') AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY created_at ASC;

INSERT INTO promoted_knowledge (id, tenant_id, owner_id, category, scope, target_ref, learned_rule, confidence_score, status, promotion_mode, promotion_policy_version, promotion_score, risk_level, frequency, learning_run_id, idempotency_key, approved_by, approved_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, 'rafael', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::numeric, $8, $9, $10, $11::numeric, $12, $13::integer, $14, $15, CASE WHEN $9 = 'AUTO' THEN 'SYSTEM_LEARNING_ENGINE' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN $9 = 'AUTO' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW(), frequency = promoted_knowledge.frequency + 1 RETURNING id, tenant_id, status, promotion_mode, learned_rule, $16 AS text, $17::bigint AS chat_id;
